_comment: Step 17 retrieval evaluation benchmark. Fixed BEFORE any semantic/hybrid results have ever been reviewed, per the milestone's explicit no-cherry-picking requirement — do not edit query wording or add/remove queries after seeing output from scripts/ai-retrieval-eval.ts. Categories: exact (known name/term/title fragment — lexical FTS should usually win or tie), conceptual (a described idea, no guaranteed keyword overlap), cross_vocabulary (deliberately worded differently than likely article phrasing), filtered (combined with an existing source/time/bookmark filter).

queries.query: efficient training of small language models
AI systems that use tools autonomously
safety research about deceptive behavior in AI
techniques for grounding LLM answers in external information
reducing hallucinations in large language models

queries.intent: should surface RAG / grounding articles despite no keyword overlap

queries.query: AI that can browse the web and click buttons
queries.intent: should surface agentic / tool-use / browser-automation articles

queries.query: shrinking neural networks without losing accuracy
queries.intent: should surface distillation / quantization / pruning articles

queries.query: teaching computers to write code that fixes itself
queries.intent: should surface self-healing / autonomous coding-agent articles

queries.notes: meaningful only once at least one relevant item is bookmarked in the corpus being evaluated against; an empty result from every strategy is itself a valid, informative outcome (confirms the filter isn't silently ignored) if nothing is bookmarked yet
